scope: Remaining Ki Blast Evasive index anomalies

records.name: Saiyan Blaster
records.notes: Broly (DB Super) exclusive evasive; current Evasive reference lists it in DLC Ki Blast Evasives without an unlock route. Individual page says it is used by Broly (DB Super).

records.name: Flash Strike (Evasive)
records.notes: Current Evasive reference classifies this as a cast-exclusive evasive for SSGSS Vegeta (Evolved). Do not confuse with the separate CaC-usable Flash Strike Ki Blast Super.

records.name: Flames of Retribution
records.notes: Fused Zamasu (Half-Corrupted)'s exclusive Evasive variant; same named technique also exists as a Ki Blast Super, but the Evasive variant consumes Stamina.

records.name: Total Evasion
records.notes: Current Evasive reference classifies this as cast-exclusive for Android 21. Do not infer CaC access from similarly named/general evasive behavior.

records.name: Peeler Storm
records.unlock_method: Expert Mission 20 - Harbinger of Doom / Crystal Raid Skill
records.notes: Special case: the move normally functions as a 300-Ki Super for bosses/cast users, but for the Time Patroller it is an Evasive using 100 Stamina. Dragon Ball Wiki explicitly states the Time Patroller can acquire it from Expert Mission 20 as a Crystal Raid Skill.

conflicts.issue: Current individual page says 400 Stamina; older/secondary lists may omit or misstate the cost. Current page retained.
Same technique has Super and Evasive implementations; repository should model the Evasive implementation as 100 Stamina and separately document its 300 Ki boss/Super implementation.
